liu_qra.quantity: share of valid airspace in the cell where the local wind pushes a drone into a building wall within the critical time

properties.p_r<resistance>: empirical probability over the SMHI observation period
properties.fw_r<resistance>: unsafe area fraction per speed bin, worst case over CFD directions
properties.fd_r<resistance>: unsafe area fraction per CFD direction, per speed bin
properties.coverage: share of the cell that carries valid CFD samples

liu_qra.speed_reference: SMHI station wind speed; the CFD field scales linearly with it
